title: ASC 820 Fair Value Support - DemoCo Digital Asset Positions
conclusionSummary: Fair value support for two digital asset positions as of 2026-06-30: 1,000 ETH measured at 2,500,000 USD using unadjusted quoted prices (level 1), and 100,000 restricted LCK tokens measured at 150,000 USD using a market approach with a 25% discount for lack of marketability (level 3, supported by a reviewed judgment). Synthetic demo data.
